answer: Seed a verifiable delay-function chain from public epoch randomness and require one proof before each reward slot. Sequential squarings cannot be parallelized within a key, while peers verify the compact proof cheaply; each extra alias needs its own full delay stream, so a farm pays in time and dedicated hardware rather than cheap signatures. Rotate seeds at the epoch boundary to stop precomputation. A spiral of keys crossing one bridge cannot fill the garden for free.
